在动作映射中添加动作，输入选择「触摸板上滑／下滑／左滑／右滑」，即可分别绑定按键: Add an action and choose Touchpad swipe up, down, left or right as its input to assign a key. Touchpad mouse does not need to be enabled.
沿主要方向滑动超过触摸板约 18% 的距离触发一次，输出约 120 ms；抬手后: Moving more than approximately 18% of the pad along the dominant axis produces one pulse of about 120 ms. Lift the finger before swiping again. Matching directions from two fingers or pads are combined. Use the default Hold activation.
